title: Codfish cakes for a kite day
text: A home version of Bermuda’s Good Friday codfish cake: soaked salt cod, potato, onion, parsley, and thyme, fried. Recipes on the island vary.

title: Hot cross buns
text: A home batch of hot cross buns for Good Friday: an enriched raisin dough, a flour cross, and a light sugar glaze.

title: Stovetop undhiyu
text: A stovetop home undhiyu for Uttarayan: winter vegetables, a coconut-herb paste, and fried fenugreek dumplings. The buried-pot method is described, not reproduced.

title: Peanut chikki
text: Peanut and jaggery brittle to nibble while flying kites at Uttarayan. A home batch, with a warning about hot sugar.

title: Tilgul laddoos
text: Sesame and jaggery laddoos for Makar Sankranti, the sweet Maharashtra Tourism and the BBC describe people exchanging.

title: A shortened fiambre
text: A small cold salad in the spirit of Guatemalan fiambre for 1 November. A family fiambre uses many more ingredients.

title: Qingtuan, with a note on the green
text: Green glutinous rice balls for Qingming. Mugwort or barley grass is the traditional color. Spinach juice is named here only as a stand-in.

title: Kite sandwiches
text: KiteKitchen original. Diamond sandwiches with a bread tail, for a park picnic. Not a festival tradition.

title: Kite sugar cookies
text: KiteKitchen original. Diamond sugar cookies with icing spars and a small tail. Not a traditional recipe.

title: Kite hand pies

title: Park kite mix
text: KiteKitchen original. A salty-sweet tin of chickpeas, peanuts, seeds, and dried mango to take to the field.

text: Fried garlic and ghee with cumin: nutty, savory, and aromatic.

title: Tamarind-Date Chutney
text: Tamarind, date, and jaggery: sour, sweet, and dark.

title: Tapenade
text: Black olive, caper, and anchovy: salty, briny, and rich.

title: Tartar Sauce
text: Mayonnaise, pickle, and capers: creamy, sharp, and briny.

title: Teriyaki Sauce
text: Soy, mirin, and sugar: salty, sweet, and glossy.

title: Texas Mop Sauce
text: Vinegar, black pepper, and beef drippings: thin, peppery, and savory.

title: Thai Sweet Chili Sauce
text: Sugar, vinegar, garlic, and chile: sweet, sharp, and lightly hot.

title: Thousand Island Dressing
text: Mayonnaise, ketchup, and pickle relish: creamy, sweet, and tangy.

title: Tikka Masala Sauce
text: Tomato, cream, and spices: mildly hot, sweet, and rich.

title: Tkemali
text: Sour plum, garlic, and herbs: tart, fruity, and savory.

title: Tomato Gravy
text: Tomato, milk, and a soft roux: tangy, savory, and pale red.

title: Tonkatsu Sauce
text: Worcestershire-style sauce, tomato, and fruit: thick, sweet, and savory.

title: Toum
text: Garlic and oil, whipped: fluffy, sharp, and intense.

title: Toyomansi
text: Soy and calamansi: salty, bright, and thin.

title: Trinidadian Pepper Sauce
text: Scotch bonnet or Congo pepper, vinegar, and garlic: very hot and sharp.

title: Tzatziki
text: Yogurt, cucumber, garlic, and dill: cool, sharp, and thick.

title: Velouté
text: Light stock and a blond roux: silky, savory, and pale.

title: Vinaigrette
text: Vinegar, mustard, and oil: sharp, salty, and fresh.

title: Vindaloo
text: Vinegar, garlic, and hot chile: sharp, hot, and savory.

title: Vodka Sauce
text: Tomato, cream, and a splash of vodka: smooth, rich, and lightly sharp.

title: Wasakaka
text: Lime, garlic, and oregano: sharp, herbal, and savory.

title: White Clam Sauce
text: Clam, garlic, white wine, and olive oil: briny and sharp.

title: Wisconsin Beer Cheese
text: Cheddar, beer, and mustard: sharp, malty, and smooth.

title: Worcestershire Sauce
text: Anchovy, vinegar, molasses, and tamarind: salty, sour, and deep.

title: Xnipec
text: Habenero, onion, and sour orange: very hot, sharp, and fresh.

title: XO Sauce
text: Dried scallop, shrimp, ham, and chile in oil: savory, smoky, and rich.

title: Yangnyeom Sauce
text: Gochujang, ketchup, garlic, and sugar: sweet, hot, and sticky.

title: Yassa
text: Onion, lemon or lime, and chile: sharp, sweet, and savory.

title: Yuxiang Sauce
text: Doubanjiang, garlic, vinegar, and sugar: hot, sweet, and sour.

title: Zabaglione
text: Egg yolk, sugar, and Marsala: warm, sweet, and winy.

title: Zhug
text: Cilantro, hot chile, garlic, and cardamom: bright, hot, and aromatic.

title: Acadian ployes
text: Mild buckwheat, a little sour from the grain, with a holey top and a soft underside.

title: Adai
text: A sturdy mixed-lentil pancake, peppery and hot from dried chile, with curry leaf in the batter.

title: Aebleskiver
text: Round Danish pancakes from a molded pan, cardamom, jam, and powdered sugar.

title: Afghan bolani
text: Crisp stuffed flatbread filled with seasoned potato and leek, mild with green chile.

title: Äggakaka
text: A thick Scanian egg pancake, served with fried pork and lingonberries.

title: Åland pancake
text: A baked porridge pancake from Åland, cardamom-scented, with prune jam.

title: Alaska sourdough flapjacks
text: Mildly sour wheat cakes, a little richer from evaporated milk, with a browned edge.

title: Flija
text: A layered Albanian batter dish, baked in many thin sheets until the top is golden.

title: Algerian mahjouba
text: Thin semolina flatbread folded around a tomato, onion, and chile filling.

title: Aloo paratha
text: A wheat flatbread stuffed with spiced potato, griddled in ghee until the surface is spotted and flaky.

title: Amboli
text: A soft, spongy, lightly sour rice pancake from the Konkan coast.

title: Apam balik
text: A turnover pancake folded over crushed peanuts, sugar, and a little butter.

title: Appalachian buckwheat cakes
text: Earthly and slightly sour, with a gray-brown crumb and a sorghum finish if you use it at the table.

title: Appalachian dried-apple pancakes
text: Soft wheat cakes with chewy, tart pieces of dried apple and a hint of cinnamon.

title: Appalachian sorghum pancakes
text: Malty and lightly bitter-sweet from sorghum, with a plain wheat crumb underneath.

title: Appam
text: A bowl-shaped rice hopper with a lacy crisp rim, a spongy sweet center, and coconut in the batter.

title: Apple cider pancakes
text: Reduced sweet cider and soft apple pieces in a lightly spiced wheat cake.

title: Arepa boyacense
text: A lightly sweet highland cake of corn and wheat, studded with cuajada and cooked on a griddle.

title: Arepa de choclo
text: A thick sweet-corn cake with pockets of fresh cheese, griddled until the edges brown.

title: Arepa de huevo
text: A fried corn cake with a whole egg cooked inside, crisp outside and set in the middle.

title: Arepa santandereana
text: A thick yellow-corn cake, griddled, served with crisp pork chicharrón.

title: Argentine panqueques
text: Thin milk crepes rolled around dulce de leche, with a browned-butter edge.

title: Jingalov hats
text: A thin griddled flatbread packed with a large handful of salted herbs and greens.

title: Australian pancakes
text: Wide, thin lemon-and-sugar pancakes with a lacy brown rim and a soft center.

title: Australian pikelets
text: Small, thick drop pancakes with a soft crumb, eaten with butter and jam at tea.

title: Azerbaijani qutab
text: Thin half-moon flatbread stuffed with herbs, finished with sumac.

title: Bacon griddle cakes
text: Salty, smoky bacon in a lightly sweet wheat pancake, cooked in bacon fat.

title: Bahamian johnnycake
text: A mildly sweet wheat cake, buttery, cooked covered in a skillet so the center steams.

title: Bananas Foster pancakes
text: A plain buttermilk pancake under bananas in brown sugar, butter, cinnamon, and rum.

title: Chitoi pitha
text: Small, soft rice cakes with a dimpled top, mild and a little sweet if date molasses is poured on.

title: Banh khot
text: Tiny crisp-edged rice cakes from a dimpled pan, each topped with a shrimp and a soft coconut center.

title: Banh xeo
text: A turmeric-yellow rice crepe, crisp at the edge, filled with pork, shrimp, and bean sprouts.

title: Basque talo
text: A griddled corn flatbread from the Basque Country, often wrapped around sausage or eaten with cider.

title: Belarusian draniki
text: Belarusian potato pancakes bound with potato starch and egg, sour cream on the side.

title: Besan cheela
text: A savory gram-flour pancake with onion, ajwain, and cumin, soft in the middle and spotted brown.

title: Bindaetteok
text: A coarse mung-bean pancake with pork, sour kimchi, and a toasted sesame edge.

title: Blinchiki
text: Thin Russian crepes rolled around a sweet farmer-cheese filling.

title: Bolivian buñuelos
text: Puffed fried dough scented with anise, served beside a cup of api, not cooked in it.

title: Brazilian beiju
text: A plain tapioca flatbread, soft or crisp depending on how long it stays on the griddle, with almost no seasoning.

title: Brazilian panquecas
text: Thin wheat crepes rolled around seasoned ground beef and a simple tomato sauce.

title: Brazilian tapioca crepes
text: A lacy crepe of hydrated tapioca starch, folded over fresh cheese, chewy and mild.

title: Buchujeon
text: A garlic-chive pancake, green and savory, with a light wheat crust and no seafood.

title: Buckwheat blini
text: Yeasted buckwheat blini, earthier than the wheat cakes, for butter and sour cream.

title: Bulgarian palachinki
text: Thin Bulgarian pancakes with yogurt in the batter, sweet or with white cheese.

title: Mont lin maya
text: A pair of small rice cakes from a dimpled pan, one plain and one topped with split peas and shallot, joined together.

title: Cachapas
text: Coarse sweet-corn pancakes folded over fresh white cheese, juicy rather than bready.

title: Cape Cod cranberry hotcakes
text: Tart cranberry pieces in a lightly sweet, orange-scented wheat cake.

title: Cheese blintzes
text: A thin, lightly sweet pancake wrapped around tangy soft cheese and fried in butter.

title: Chilote milcao
text: Pan-fried cakes of raw and cooked potato, salty, crisp at the edge, and dense inside.

title: Chilean panqueques
text: Thin wheat crepes filled with manjar and finished with a dry dust of powdered sugar.

title: Chilean sopaipillas
text: Fried pumpkin rounds, crisp and puffed, eaten with pebre or with chancaca syrup.

title: Chocolate chip pancakes
text: A plain sweet pancake with pockets of melted semisweet chocolate.

title: Colombian arepas
text: A thinner white-corn arepa with cheese in the dough, buttered, beside tomato and scallion hogao.

title: Cong you bing
text: A flaky wheat cake layered with scallion and oil, crisp outside and chewy within.

title: Corn oysters
text: Sweet corn, egg, and pepper, fried in small irregular cakes.

title: Corn tortillas
text: Soft, toasted corn with a faint mineral note from nixtamal, cooked dry on a hot comal.

title: Costa Rican chorreadas
text: Sweet fresh-corn pancakes, lightly eggy, served with sour cream.

title: Breton crepes
text: Thin wheat crepes from Brittany, butter and sugar, the cake of Chandeleur.

title: Crêpes Suzette
text: Thin crepes in orange butter, with a warm orange sauce.

title: Crespelle
text: Italian crepes, plain or baked. Crespelle alla fiorentina is one variation, not the only form.

title: Croatian palačinke
text: Croatian crepes rolled with fresh cheese, lemon, and raisins.

title: Cuban torrejas
text: Day-old bread soaked in egg and milk, fried, and finished with cinnamon syrup and a splash of wine.

title: Czech lívance
text: Small yeasted Czech pancakes served with quark and jam, not rolled.

title: Czech palačinky
text: Thin Czech crepes filled with sweet quark and raisins.

title: Dadar gulung
text: A green pandan crepe rolled around grated coconut and palm sugar.

title: Danish pandekager
text: Thin Danish pancakes, rolled with sugar or jam.

title: Derbyshire oatcakes
text: A yeasted oatmeal pancake from Derbyshire, a little thicker than the Staffordshire shop cake.

title: Deruny
text: Ukrainian grated-potato pancakes, fried crisp and served with sour cream.

title: Diner silver-dollar pancakes
text: Mild, buttery, and lightly sweet, with more browned edge than center because the cakes are small.

title: Djiboutian lahoh
text: Small, holey breakfast cakes, mildly sour, with a soft wheat crumb.

title: Dominican casabe
text: A thin, dry cassava flatbread, lightly salty, crisp at the edge and bland in a way that suits a stew.

title: Dominican yaniqueques
text: Small wheat rounds, salty and toasted, cooked in a slick of oil until both sides spot.

title: Dorayaki
text: Two small golden-brown pancakes sandwiched around sweet red bean paste.

title: Drie-in-de-pan
text: Three small Dutch pancakes in the pan, with apple in the batter.

title: Dutch baby
text: Eggy, custardy in the center, and crisp at the lifted rim, with browned butter.

title: Dutch pannenkoeken
text: Large, thin Dutch pancakes, plate-sized, with syrup, apple, or bacon.

title: Egg foo young
text: A thick egg pancake with bean sprouts and onion, covered in a brown gravy.

title: Egg hoppers
text: A coconut rice hopper with a soft egg set in the center, crisp at the rim.

title: Egyptian qatayef
text: Yeasted pancakes stuffed with cinnamon walnuts and soaked in a lemon-rose syrup.

title: Emirati chebab
text: Small yeasted pancakes perfumed with saffron and cardamom, served with date syrup.

title: English crumpets
text: Ring-cooked yeast cakes, toasted so butter sinks into the holes.

title: English pikelets
text: Small freeform yeast cakes with a holey top, toasted and buttered.

title: English Shrove pancakes
text: Thin egg pancakes, lemon and sugar, made to clear the kitchen before Lent.

title: Eritrean taita
text: Sour teff flatbread with a spongy top, meant to carry tsebhi.

title: Estonian kohupiim pancakes
text: Small fried cakes of Estonian kohupiim, a curd cheese, with jam.

title: Ethiopian kita
text: Mild, soft teff flatbread with a light toasted face and no sour ferment.

title: Farinata
text: Ligurian chickpea flatbread, baked thick enough to stay creamy, with oil and pepper.

title: Farmer cheese latkes
text: The older Ashkenazi Hanukkah pancake, made of farmer cheese rather than potato.

title: Ficelle picarde
text: A Picardy crepe rolled around ham and mushrooms in cream, then baked with cheese.

title: Fijian babakau
text: Soft yeasted dough, fried, with a mild sweetness and a pale, airy center.

title: Filipino hotcakes
text: Soft wheat breakfast pancakes, browned in margarine and eaten with sugar or condensed milk.

title: Filloas
text: Thin Galician Carnival pancakes, scented with anise, rolled with sugar.

title: Finnish lettu
text: Thin Finnish pancakes, served with jam, sugar, or whipped cream.

title: Flemish pannekoeken
text: Thick Flemish pancakes, finished with brown sugar and butter.

title: Flensjes
text: Paper-thin Frisian crepes, stacked or rolled with sugar.

title: Florida plantain pancakes
text: Sweet ripe plantain, a little cinnamon, and a fried edge.

title: Flour tortillas
text: Soft, wheaty, and a little rich from fat, with browned spots and a flexible crumb.

title: Frixuelos
text: Asturian Carnival pancakes, a little richer than Galician filloas, with lemon.

title: Galette complète
text: A buckwheat galette with ham, cheese, and an egg cooked in the middle.

title: Buckwheat galette
text: A savory Breton buckwheat crepe, lacy and a little bitter, cooked on a billig.

title: Galette-saucisse
text: A pork sausage rolled in a buckwheat galette, the Rennes street snack.

title: Gamjajeon
text: A pan-fried potato cake, crisp at the lace and soft inside, with scallion and sesame.

title: Gaziantep katmer
text: Crisp layered flatbread filled with pistachio and kaymak, which is clotted cream.

title: Georgia peach pancakes
text: Juicy ripe peach against a tangy buttermilk crumb, sweet but not candied.

title: Georgian mchadi
text: Dense cornmeal cakes with a toasted crust and a mildly sweet grain center.

title: German Eierkuchen
text: Thin German egg pancakes. In Berlin, do not call them Pfannkuchen.

title: Ghanaian tatale
text: Sweet ripe plantain fritters with ginger and a mild chile warmth, fried until the edges crisp.

title: Gingerbread pancakes
text: Dark molasses, ginger, cinnamon, and clove in a soft wheat cake.

title: Goan alebele
text: A thin, tender crepe rolled around fresh coconut and jaggery, with cardamom in the filling.

title: Gorditas
text: Thick toasted masa, split and filled with mashed beans, fresh cheese, and a mild salsa.

title: Greek tiganites
text: Small Greek fried pancakes finished with honey and cinnamon.

title: Haemul pajeon
text: A crisp scallion pancake threaded with shrimp and squid, mild chile in the dip.

title: Haitian accras
text: Fried grated malanga, herb-heavy and crisp, with a soft center that has to be cooked through.

title: Hawaiian banana-macadamia hotcakes
text: Ripe banana and toasted macadamia in a rich diner hotcake.

title: Hiroshima okonomiyaki
text: A layered savory crepe: thin batter, a mound of cabbage, noodles, pork, and egg, finished with sauce.

title: Honduran baleadas
text: A soft griddled wheat tortilla folded over refried beans and crumbled cheese.

title: Hopi piki
text: Very thin toasted blue corn, delicate and dry enough to fold, with a mineral note if ash is used.

title: Hortobágyi palacsinta
text: Hungarian crepes filled with paprika chicken, folded, and baked with sour cream.

title: Hotteok
text: A chewy street pancake split by molten brown sugar, cinnamon, and walnut.

title: Hudson Valley buckwheat cakes
text: Sour, earthy buckwheat with a molasses edge and a crisp griddle face.

title: Hungarian palacsinta
text: Thin Hungarian crepes rolled with apricot jam.

title: Icelandic lummur
text: Small thick Icelandic pancakes with rye, buttered and sugared.

title: Icelandic pönnukökur
text: Very thin Icelandic pancakes, rolled with sugar or rhubarb jam.

title: Imagawayaki
text: A round filled cake cooked in a hinged iron, with sweet red bean paste sealed inside a soft wheat shell.

title: Indian slapjack
text: Soft corn, milk, and egg, with only a little wheat to hold the cake.

title: Injera
text: Sour, spongy teff bread with an earthy crumb and open holes on top.

title: Irish boxty
text: Pan boxty: raw grated potato and mashed potato, fried as cakes.

title: Irish oatmeal pancakes
text: Soft oatmeal pancakes with buttermilk, a breakfast cake from Irish kitchens.

title: Irish potato farls
text: Mashed-potato farls, cut in quarters and cooked on a griddle.

title: Jamaican bammy
text: A dense, mild cassava round, dry and toasted on the outside, then fried so the edge crisps.

title: Jamaican festival
text: Sweet cornmeal and wheat dumplings, fried until deep gold, with a soft center.

title: Japanese hotcakes
text: Thick, soft cafe hotcakes with a browned top, butter, and syrup, taller than a thin crepe and gentler than a souffle cake.

title: Jowar dosa
text: A pale sorghum dosa, mildly sweet and peppery, with a dry crisp edge.

title: Kaiserschmarrn
text: A torn, caramelized Austrian pancake with raisins and plum compote.

title: Kartoffelpuffer
text: Shredded German potato pancakes, crisp, with applesauce.

title: Kenyan chapati
text: Soft, flaky wheat flatbread with a lightly oiled, toasted surface.

title: Kenyan vitumbua
text: Yeasted rice cakes scented with coconut and cardamom, crisp on the curve and soft inside.

title: Khanom bueang
text: A crisp rice crepe folded around a sweet coconut-egg topping, lacy at the edge.

title: Khanom krok
text: Small coconut-rice cakes with a browned rim and a soft, sweet center, cooked in a dimpled pan.

title: Kimchi jeon
text: A tangy, medium-hot pancake of ripe kimchi in a wheat batter, crisp at the edge.

title: Kolbullar
text: A simple pork and flour pancake from the charcoal woods of central Sweden.

title: Kue ape
text: A small coconut-rice cake with a crisp rim and a soft center that sinks into a crater.

title: Kuzhi paniyaram
text: Small fermented rice-and-urad balls, crisp outside, soft inside, with mustard seed and curry leaf.

title: Lacy cornbread
text: Crisp, salty corn with a brittle lace of holes and a tender spot in the middle.

title: Lancashire potato cakes
text: Thick mashed-potato cakes, fried, from Lancashire breakfasts.

title: Latvian potato pancakes
text: Latvian pancakes of half mashed and half raw potato, with dill, fried in butter.

title: Lebanese manakish
text: Soft round flatbread topped with thyme, sumac, sesame, and olive oil.

title: Lemon ricotta pancakes
text: Soft, custardy ricotta cakes with bright lemon zest and a light crumb.

title: Lithuanian bulviniai blynai
text: Lithuanian potato pancakes with kefir in the batter, fried and served with sour cream.

title: Llapingachos
text: Pan-fried potato cakes with cheese inside and a mild peanut sauce over the top.

title: Lowcountry rice griddle cakes
text: Soft, lightly sweet rice cakes with a crisp buttered edge and separate grains in the crumb.

title: Maine blueberry pancakes
text: Tart wild blueberries bursting into a buttered, lightly sweet wheat cake.

title: Mofo gasy
text: Small, sweet rice cakes with a yeasted crumb and a browned top.

title: Malawach
text: Flaky laminated flatbread, salty and toasted, with a pull-apart layer at the edge.

title: Malpua
text: A fried sweet pancake, fennel-scented, soaked in sugar syrup until the edges lacquer.

title: Mandarin pancakes
text: Very thin wheat pancakes, soft and faintly sesame-scented, made to wrap crisp duck skin and meat.

title: Parāoa parai
text: Fried wheat bread, puffed and crisp at the rim, with a soft, salty interior.

title: Martabak manis
text: A thick, sweet pancake, also called terang bulan, topped with chocolate, cheese, and peanuts.

title: Martabak telur
text: A thin, crisp wheat skin folded around a juicy filling of egg, seasoned beef, and onion.

title: Martinican accras de morue
text: Salt-cod fritters in a wheat batter, garlicky and medium-hot, fried until the crust shatters.

title: Masala dosa
text: A fermented rice-and-urad sheet wrapped around a turmeric potato filling, with curry leaf and green chile.

title: Matzo brei
text: Soft scrambled egg bound around soaked matzo, salty and toasted in butter.

title: Mauritian crepes
text: Thin French Creole crepes with a vanilla batter, folded over brown sugar.

title: Memiljeon
text: A nutty buckwheat pancake, earthy and a little bitter, bound with egg and scallion.

title: Mexican buñuelos
text: Thin, crisp fried dough with anise, broken into shards and soaked with piloncillo and cinnamon syrup.

title: Mexican hotcakes
text: Soft wheat cakes with browned butter, finished with cajeta, honey, or condensed milk.

title: Michigan cherry pancakes
text: Tart cherry against a lightly sweet buttermilk cake.

title: Minnesota wild rice pancakes
text: A wheat pancake with chewy, toasted grains of wild rice scattered through it.

title: Molasses pancakes
text: Strong, dark molasses in a tender wheat crumb, bittersweet rather than floral.

title: Monjayaki
text: A loose, runny savory batter cooked on a griddle and eaten while it is still half set.

title: Moong dal cheela
text: A soft yellow-lentil pancake, bright with ginger and green chile, less nutty than a besan cheela.

title: Moroccan baghrir
text: Spongy semolina cakes, yeasted and sour-sweet, soaked with butter and honey.

title: Moroccan harcha
text: Crumbly semolina pan bread, buttery and lightly salty, with a toasted crust.

title: Msemen
text: Flaky, lightly salty layered flatbread with toasted semolina between the folds.

title: Mysore masala dosa
text: A crisp fermented dosa spread inside with red chile-garlic chutney and a line of potato masala.

title: Nalysnyky
text: Ukrainian crepes rolled with cheese and baked in sour cream.

title: Navajo frybread
text: Fried wheat dough, blistered and salty, crisp outside and soft inside.

title: Neer dosa
text: A soft, pale, almost translucent rice roll with a clean cereal taste and no sour ferment.

title: Negiyaki
text: A scallion-heavy savory pancake, sweeter and greener than cabbage okonomiyaki, with a soft wheat crumb.

title: Nei appam
text: A sweet, dense rice cake scented with banana, jaggery, cardamom, and ghee.

title: Chatamari
text: A thin Newar rice crepe topped with egg, onion, and a little chile.

title: New England cornmeal cakes
text: Coarse corn and molasses against a tangy buttermilk crumb.

title: New Mexico blue corn hotcakes
text: Toasted blue corn in a tender buttermilk cake, nutty and a little sweet.

title: New Orleans calas
text: Fried rice fritters, lightly sweet, with nutmeg and a powdered-sugar coat.

title: New Zealand pikelets
text: Small tea-table pikelets with a golden edge, finished with butter and golden syrup.

title: Newfoundland toutons
text: Fried bread dough, crisp at the rim, with salt pork and a side of molasses.

title: Nicaraguan güirilas
text: Thick young-corn pancakes with cuajada folded in, savory and a little milky, barely sweet.

title: Nigerian masa
text: Mildly sour rice cakes with crisp rims and a soft, slightly sweet center.

title: Normandy apple crepes
text: Wheat crepes filled with apples cooked in butter, a Normandy dessert.

title: Norwegian lefse
text: Potato lefse, rolled thin and griddled, soft enough to fold with butter and sugar.

title: Oaxacan memelas
text: An elongated masa cake spread with oil, black beans, and a mild salsa, toasted at the edges.

title: Oladyi
text: Small thick Russian pancakes on kefir, quicker than yeasted blini.

title: Onion rava dosa
text: Crisp semolina lace crowded with sweet onion, green chile, and curry leaf.

title: Osaka okonomiyaki
text: A thick savory pancake with cabbage mixed into the batter, topped with sauce, mayonnaise, and bonito flakes.

title: Pajeon
text: A savory wheat pancake packed with scallion, crisp at the rim and tender in the middle.

title: Palak cheela
text: A green spinach and gram-flour pancake, savory with ginger and cumin, soft rather than crisp.

title: Paper dosa
text: A very large, very thin fermented rice sheet that shatters at the edge and tastes toasted.

title: Paraguayan mbeju
text: A crisp griddled cake of manioc starch, cornmeal, and cheese, salty at the edge and tender in the middle.

title: Patishapta
text: A soft rice-and-wheat crepe rolled around a coconut and jaggery filling, fragrant with cardamom.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch funnel cakes
text: Crisp fried batter, lightly eggy, buried under powdered sugar.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch potato pancakes
text: Shredded potato, onion, and pepper, crisp at the edge and soft in the middle.

title: Kuku sabzi
text: A dense herb frittata, bright green inside, with walnut and a sour note from barberries.

title: Peruvian tacu-tacu
text: A pan-fried cake of leftover rice and beans, garlicky, with a crisp face and mild ají amarillo.

title: Pesarattu
text: A green-gold moong dal pancake, herbal from ginger and green chile, with a soft crisp edge.

title: Piadina
text: The griddled flatbread of Romagna. It is a flatbread, folded around a filling.

title: Placki ziemniaczane
text: Polish potato pancakes, shredded and fried, with sugar or sour cream.

title: Plain dosa
text: Crisp at the edge, faintly sour, with a toasted rice smell and a soft underside.

title: Poffertjes
text: Small yeast pancakes from a dimpled Dutch pan, buttered and dusted with sugar.

title: Pol roti
text: A griddled coconut flatbread, lightly sweet from the coconut, with onion and green chile in the dough.

title: Polish naleśniki
text: Thin Polish crepes with a sweet cheese filling, rolled and warmed.

title: Portuguese panquecas
text: Thin Portuguese crepes with orange zest, rolled with jam.

title: Portuguese rabanadas
text: Portuguese Christmas fried bread, soaked in milk and egg, with cinnamon sugar. Not a poured pancake.

title: Potato latkes
text: Ashkenazi potato pancakes for Hanukkah, fried in oil, with the older cheese custom named beside them.

title: Pudla
text: A turmeric-yellow Gujarati besan pancake, savory and a little sweet, eaten with chutney.

title: Puerto Rican almojábanas
text: Fried rice-flour and cheese fritters, crisp at the edge, salty and chewy inside.

title: Pumpkin pancakes
text: Soft pumpkin, cinnamon, and ginger in a lightly sweet wheat cake.

title: Pupusas
text: Griddled masa stuffed with beans and melting cheese, served with tangy curtido and a light tomato salsa.

title: Racuchy
text: Small yeasted Polish pancakes with apple, dusted with sugar.

title: Raggmunk
text: Crisp Swedish potato pancakes from raw grated potato, with lingonberries.

title: Ragi dosa
text: An earthy, malt-dark finger-millet dosa with a mild chile edge and a crisp skin.

title: Rava dosa
text: A lacy, cracker-crisp semolina sheet scented with cumin, black pepper, and curry leaf.

title: Rhode Island johnnycakes
text: Toasted corn, salt, and a crisp edge, with almost no sweetness in the cake itself.

title: Romanian clătite
text: Thin Romanian crepes with jam or sweet cheese, a home dessert.

title: Roti canai
text: A flaky, laminated wheat flatbread, griddled until the outside shatters and the inside stays stretchy.

title: Russian blini
text: Yeasted wheat blini for Maslenitsa, butter week, with sour cream and butter.

title: Markook saj bread
text: Paper-thin wheat flatbread, soft and lightly smoky from a few seconds on a dome.

title: Samoan panikeke
text: Round fried cakes, lightly sweet, with mashed banana in a soft wheat crumb.

title: San Francisco sourdough pancakes
text: Tangy sourdough in a thin, buttered wheat pancake.

title: Saudi mutabbaq
text: A thin, pan-fried stuffed flatbread with a savory leek and egg center and a mild chile edge.

title: Scotch pancakes
text: Small thick drop scones from a Scottish girdle, butter and jam.

title: Scottish oatcakes
text: Thin, dry, unleavened oatcakes from a Scottish girdle.

title: Serabi
text: A small, thick coconut-rice pancake with a porous face, served with palm-sugar syrup.

title: Serbian palačinke
text: Thin Serbian crepes rolled with plum jam.

title: Set dosa
text: Thick, soft, and mildly sour, with a spongy face and a pale golden underside.

title: Shandong jianbing
text: A very thin, cracker-crisp crepe, torn into pieces and eaten with scallion and a savory paste.

title: Singaporean roti prata
text: A flaky laminated flatbread from a Singapore coffee shop, crisp at the edge and chewy inside, served with curry.

title: Singing hinnies
text: Currant griddle cakes from Northumberland. The fat sizzles, which is the singing.

title: Skillet bannock
text: Plain wheat bread, slightly salty, with a fried face and a soft center.

title: Slovak palačinky
text: Thin Slovak crepes rolled with cocoa and sugar, a home filling without a brand of spread.

title: Socca
text: A crisp-edged chickpea flatbread from Nice, eaten hot with black pepper.

title: Somali canjeero
text: Soft, lightly sour wheat cakes full of small holes, mildly sweet at the edge.

title: Sopes
text: A small thick masa base with a raised rim, topped with beans, cheese, onion, and salsa.

title: Souffle hotcakes
text: Extremely thick, jiggly pancakes with a browned cap and a soft, egg-white interior.

title: South African pannekoek
text: Thin wheat pancakes rolled around cinnamon sugar, with a buttery edge.

title: Southeastern corn griddle cakes
text: Plain corn, salt, and a toasted surface, with no sugar and no wheat.

title: Southern banana pancakes
text: Ripe banana mashed into a tangy buttermilk pancake, soft and sweet.

title: Southern buttermilk pancakes
text: Tangy buttermilk, a little sugar, and a soft crumb with a browned rim.

title: Southern hoecakes
text: Plain toasted corn, salt, and a fried edge, denser than a wheat pancake.

title: Spanish tortilla de patatas
text: A potato omelet. It is not a pancake. This page says so and still cooks the omelet.

title: Spanish tortitas
text: Small thick Spanish pancakes with lemon, a home breakfast, not a tortilla.

title: Spekdik
text: A thick Groningen buckwheat pancake with bacon in the batter, served with syrup.

title: Spring pancakes
text: Soft wheat wrappers for the start of spring, rolled around shredded vegetables and a savory-sweet sauce.

title: Sri Lankan coconut pancakes
text: A thin sweet crepe rolled with grated coconut and jaggery, meant for tea time.

title: Sri Lankan hoppers
text: A crisp-edged rice bowl with a soft coconut center and a light ferment tang.

title: Staffordshire oatcakes
text: Large, soft, yeasted oatmeal pancakes from the Potteries, rolled around a savory filling.

title: Sudanese kisra
text: Thin, tangy sorghum sheets with a flexible, faintly bitter grain taste.

title: Svele
text: Thick west-Norwegian pancakes, the ferry kiosk cake, with jam or brown whey cheese.

title: Swedish pannkakor
text: Thin Swedish pancakes, pan-cooked, served with lingonberry jam.

title: Swedish plättar
text: Tiny Swedish pancakes from a plätt pan, with jam and cream.

title: Sweet potato pancakes
text: Orange-fleshed sweet potato, a little cinnamon, and a moist wheat crumb.

title: Swiss rösti
text: A shredded potato cake from Switzerland, pan-fried as one round. Not a batter pancake.

title: Syrniki
text: Pan-fried Russian farmer-cheese cakes, with sour cream and jam.

title: Taiwanese danbing
text: A thin breakfast crepe with egg cooked on its face, brushed with soy sauce and rolled with scallion.

title: Taiwanese oyster omelet
text: A soft, starch-set omelet crowded with oysters, finished with a sweet-savory sauce and greens.

title: Takoyaki
text: Crisp-edged batter balls with a piece of octopus in the center, finished with sauce and bonito.

title: Tattie scones
text: Thin potato triangles from a Scottish girdle, eaten at breakfast.

title: Texas pecan pancakes
text: Buttered wheat cakes with toasted pecan, sweet and slightly bitter at the brown edge of the nut.

title: Thai roti
text: A stretched, griddled wheat bread, crisp and chewy, wrapped around banana and condensed milk.

title: Thalipeeth
text: A hearty multigrain griddle bread, onion-flecked, with toasted millet and chickpea in the crumb.

title: Tianjin jianbing
text: A soft savory crepe wrapped around egg, sauce, herbs, and a shatter of crisp fried dough.

title: Tlacoyos
text: An oval masa cake with a seam of mashed beans, topped with nopales, onion, and salsa.

title: Topfenpalatschinken
text: Austrian crepes filled with sweetened quark and baked until the cheese is warm.

title: Tortillitas de camarones
text: Crisp Cádiz fritters of tiny shrimp and chickpea flour.

title: Trinidadian dhalpuri roti
text: A soft wheat roti with a layer of seasoned ground split peas that flakes when the bread is clapped.

title: Tunisian mlawi
text: Soft, oiled, layered round with a flaky edge and a mild wheat taste.

title: Aegean akıtma
text: Thin Aegean semolina pancakes with a tangy crumb, finished with walnuts and syrup.

title: Turkish gözleme
text: Thin stuffed flatbread, griddled, with spinach and salty white cheese in the fold.

title: Turkish kaygana
text: A soft flour-and-egg skillet cake, herb-flecked, with a tender center and a browned rim.

title: Turnip cake
text: A savory daikon cake of rice flour, steamed until set, then pan-fried so the slices crust.

title: Ugandan kabalagala
text: Sweet fried cakes of ripe banana and wheat flour, crisp outside and soft within.

title: Ulster soda farls
text: Griddled soda-bread farls from Ulster, cut in quarters.

title: Upper Midwest Swedish pancakes
text: Thin, eggy, and lightly sweet, rolled around butter and jam.

title: Uruguayan panqueques
text: Thin wheat crepes rolled with firm quince paste and a slice of fresh cheese.

title: Uttapam
text: A thick, soft fermented cake topped with onion, tomato, and green chile.

title: Venezuelan arepas
text: Thick white-corn cakes, griddled until they crackle, split and filled with fresh cheese.

title: Vermont maple pancakes
text: A mild wheat cake with real maple in the batter and a stronger maple pour on top.

title: Welsh crempog
text: Welsh buttermilk griddle cakes, stacked with butter between the layers.

title: Xianbing
text: A round northern wheat cake sealed around a juicy pork and scallion filling, pan-fried until spotted.

title: Yemeni lahoh
text: Spongy sorghum cakes, sour and earthy, with holes that hold beans or egg.

title: Zambian vitumbuwa
text: Sweet coconut-rice fritters with a crisp fried crust and a soft grain center.
